name: FRRouting Layer 3 Switch Driver
notes: Installs and removes static routes on an FRR router over SSH via vtysh (netmiko, cisco_ios platform). All mutating methods honor context['dry_run']. Connection params: HERD_ip, HERD_login, HERD_password, optional HERD_port. Reference driver for the Layer 3 Switch contract; see docs/DRIVERS.md.
